ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low global contrast; visible ventral surface is approximately 95% low-intensity (black) pixels with isolated high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at the median notch and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity pigmentation across 90% of the surface area; high-intensity contiguous blobs detected at coordinates corresponding to the median notch periphery and the extreme lateral tips of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation approximately 45 degrees in angle, with a deep vertical bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serration map; continuous irregular pixel peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary, particularly pronounced on the distal segments of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve fitting the trailing edges from the median notch extending to the tips, with a secondary concave curve on the leading edge towards the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast, irregular circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) localized specifically on the dorsal and ventral surfaces of the left and right fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of parallel, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) appearing as light-grey streaks crossing the dark pigmentation of both the left and right lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified barnacle encrustation on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; presence of healed linear rake mark scars across the ventral surface.
